info.bio:
Sky Cries Mary is a trance rock musical group from Seattle, Washington that formed in the late 1980s.

The husband and wife team of Roderick Wolgamott Romero and Anisa Romero sing dual lead vocals. They tend to harmonise in thirds, evoking a mystical feel. Anisa is also an oil painter. Mike Cozzi (formerly of Shriekback) plays guitar. Gordon Raphael (producer for The Strokes) played keyboards until 1999. Ben Ireland plays drums.

scenes.name: Post-psicodelia (EE UU)
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La psicodelia, el mayor invento de los sesenta, sigue siendo el género dominante en los noventa, con los mismos estilos básicos (el pop psicodélico de los Doors, el freak-out de Red Crayola, el trance de la Velvet, la jam de los Grateful Dead) más el dream-pop y el shoegazing. Mercury Rev logran una síntesis de proporciones históricas (Yerself Is Steam, Deserter's Songs); Luna, Motion Picture, Arson Garden, Tadpoles, Uncle Wiggly, Brother J.T., Space Needle. En la Costa Oeste, Medicine, Sky Cries Mary, Brian Jonestown Massacre (enciclopedias psicodélicas), Quasi, Dandy Warhols.

podcast.title: First Professional Internet-Only Concert (1994)
podcast.body: On November 10, 1994, this Seattle group made history by performing what is believed to be the first-ever Internet-only concert by a professional band. Despite the technical challenges, which resulted in a "messy and glitchy" broadcast with poor audio, the event was lauded as a significant "technological triumph" and a pioneering step for webcasts and streaming. "The answer seems to be a Seattle group called SkyCriseMary on November 10th, 1994. It was messy and glitchy and the audio was bad, but it made history. It was a technological triumph."

podcast.title: Possible First Musical Netcast (Two Weeks Before Stones, 1994)
podcast.body: Two weeks prior to The Rolling Stones' November 1994 netcast, Seattle band Sky Cries Mary partnered with the company Starwave to deliver a live performance that many consider to be the first netcast. This event also coincided with the band's creation of their own CD-ROM, titled "Coconut Soup and other advertisers." "A lot of people say it was a band from Seattle called Sky Cry's Two weeks before the Stones performance, they partnered with a company called Star Wave to give a live performance."
